rationale: Pure PG8 remains the selected donor-energy-score model. The 40000-update continuation regressed, and changing observation representations did not improve the joint objective. Existing PG8 network rates remain constant at G .012 and D .018. Test smaller network steps while preserving the particle-row step, rather than extending the same constant-rate fit. These observations do not prove that the current rates are excessive.
recipe: Official ParticleGAN 0.9.4 get_recipe(total_steps=20000,batch_size=32,num_particles=512,z_dim=8,lr=.006,prior_lr_mult=5.). Keep every other bispf_optimized recipe field unchanged.

rates.schedule: Same native schedule and floors; verify actual rates through UpdatePolicy.

unchanged: Original pure PG8 count generator, 150 fixed moment/Fourier observations and critic, prior initialization and SBNP regularizer, native loss/penalty/optimizer/update policy, fitting donors/transforms, initialization and sampling streams, integer generation and zero real-bag replacements.
confounds: Network step sizes halve while the prior step stays constant, so the network/prior learning-rate ratio changes. Equal 20000 updates do not imply equal optimization trajectories or progress. Not a formulation-level causal conclusion.
pre_native_requirements: Isolated explicit adapter/update/config binding; preserve default PG8 and GPU1 frozen source.
Initial generator, critic and prior model states match PG8 exactly; native optimizers differ only in intended network rates.
Exact official API recipe equality with only lr and prior_lr_mult overrides; finite connected native gradients and unchanged losses/penalty/observation AST.
Full serialized model/optimizer/policy/RNG/usage restore and next-update bitwise equality on synthetic CPU fixtures; refuse mismatched config.
Qualify exact native source/config/endpoint/count binding and existing resource/accounting guards before any deployment.
Separate framework and plan-only candidate commits, fresh protected peers/capacity and one-use authorization; no automatic successor.
decision: Existing four adaptive calibration donors and two fixed generation replicates, donor energy score primary with cellED/spread/count guards against selected pure PG8. Independently audit/recompute final evidence after clean settlement; commit and actually revert rejected candidate. Same stable three-seed confirmation protocol; evaluation donors excluded from selection.
